ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) Suspicious Transactions Linked to Employee: Same or Similar Amounts

This scenario detects an account or employee that performs a sequence of withdrawal and deposit of cash transactions in same or similar amounts for a specified look back period. For an employee, activities in accounts either directly controlled (owned) by employees, or accounts that are controlled by employee family members are considered by this scenario.
SELECT a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.EMP_ACCT_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT a inner join @BUSINESS@.EMP_ACCT b on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID=b.ACCT_INTRL_ID)

SELECT a.CLNDR_DAY_AGE, 999999999 DINT, 999999999999999999 FFLOAT, '~' DSTRING, 999999999999999999 DFLOAT, ADD_MONTHS(ADD_DAYS(a.CLNDR_DT,1),120) DDATE FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL a WHERE (a.CLNDR_DAY_AGE=1 and a.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL')

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

-- Primary Rule to retrieve all the employee account who have done the cash transaction SELECT ACCT.ACCT_SEQ_ID, ACCT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ACCT.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, E.EMP_INTRL_ID, (SELECT MAX(CAL.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL WHERE CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm) CURR_DT, MAX(CASH.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB , -1 D_INT FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT ACCT INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN CASH ON ACCT.ACCT_INTRL_ID = CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP N ON CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID = N.ACCT_INTRL_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.EMP E ON E.EMP_INTRL_ID = N.EMP_INTRL_ID WHERE
-- Include only those cash transaction product types CASH.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD IN (@Incl_Cash_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) --Include customer retail accounts only AND ACCT.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CR' --Exclude exempt accounts AND ACCT.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 AND ACCT.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD IN (@oracle_bus_acct_type_lst) -- To check for Credit or Debit AND CASH.DBT_CDT_CD = @Credit_dbt_cd AND CASH.Trxn_Exctn_Dt > (SELECT ADD_DAYS(CAL.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL WHERE CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm) AND CASH.Trxn_Exctn_Dt <= (SELECT CAL.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL WHERE CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm) AND CASH.DATA_DUMP_DT > (SELECT ADD_DAYS(CAL.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL WHERE CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm) AND CASH.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (SELECT CAL.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL WHERE CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm) -- Exclude cancelled transaction AND CASH.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND CASH.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --Exclude cash transactions between related parties AND (@Incl_Rltd_Parties = 'Y' OR COALESCE(CASH.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL, 'Y') <> 'N') AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' OR CASH.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_trans_src_lst)) AND (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR ACCT.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_jurisdictions_lst)) GROUP BY ACCT.ACCT_SEQ_ID, ACCT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ACCT.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB,E.EMP_INTRL_ID

-- Primary Rule to retreive all Employee Account cash Transaction within lookback period SELECT CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID D_ACCT_ID, CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM D_TRXN_BASE_AMT, CASH.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, F_TO_NUMBER(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(CAL.CLNDR_DT, 'J')) D_CLNDR_DT, F_TO_NUMBER(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(CASH.DATA_DUMP_DT, 'J')) D_DATA_DUMP_DT, CASE WHEN CASH.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0 OR CASH.CASH_TRXN_NTITY_RISK_NB > 0 THEN CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END D_HR_TRXN_AM, 0 D_PASS_THRU_TRXN_AM, CASE WHEN CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN CASH.TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(CASH.TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END D_LRF_TRXN_AM
FROM @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN CASH, @MINER@.DSVIEW118745002 B, @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL
WHERE CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID = B.ACCT_INTRL_ID -- Include cash transaction product types AND CASH.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD IN (@Incl_Cash_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- Include Credit/debit transaction AND CASH.DBT_CDT_CD = @Credit_dbt_cd -- Minimum Individual Transaction greater than or equal to Min Indv Trans Amt AND ( (B.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND B.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Rsk_Cutoff_Lvl AND CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM >= @HR_Min_Indiv_Trans_Amt) OR (B.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND B.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB < @Actvty_Rsk_Cutoff_Lvl AND CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM >= @RR_Min_Indiv_Trans_Amt) OR (CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM >= @MR_Min_Indiv_Trans_Amt) ) --Exclude cash transactions between related parties AND (@Incl_Rltd_Parties = 'Y' OR COALESCE(CASH.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL, 'Y') <> 'N') AND CASH.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > ADD_DAYS(CAL.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) AND CASH.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= CAL.CLNDR_DT AND CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm -- Exclude Cancelled Transaction AND CASH.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND CASH.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' OR CASH.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_trans_src_lst))
